name: Wing
short: Wings help the plane stay up.
function: Wings create lift, which helps the aircraft rise and stay in the sky.
ifMissing: The plane cannot lift properly and may never leave the ground.
lesson: A plane needs enough lift to fly. Bigger or better-shaped wings help for longer or steadier trips.

name: Tail
short: The tail keeps the plane steady.
function: The tail helps the aircraft balance and turn more safely.
ifMissing: The plane may wobble, tip, or lose direction control.
lesson: The tail is like a helper that keeps the airplane calm and pointed in the right direction.

name: Engine
short: The engine pushes the plane forward.
function: The engine creates thrust so the plane can move fast enough to fly.
ifMissing: The plane cannot gain enough speed for takeoff.
lesson: Planes need thrust. Without forward push, even good wings will not be enough.

name: Landing Gear
short: Landing gear helps the plane land safely.
function: Landing gear supports the aircraft during takeoff, landing, and taxiing.
ifMissing: Landing becomes rough, unsafe, and likely to damage the plane.
lesson: A good flight is not only about takeoff. Safe landing matters too.

name: Fuel Tank
short: The fuel tank feeds the engine.
function: The fuel tank stores the fuel that powers the engine during flight.
ifMissing: The engine may stop before the mission is complete.
lesson: A plane needs energy for the whole journey, not just the beginning.

name: Radar
function: Radar helps with navigation and safer flying in difficult or rescue missions.
ifMissing: The mission may not have enough support in tricky conditions.
lesson: Some flights need more than basic parts. Smart missions need smart guidance tools.

name: Cargo Bay
function: Cargo space lets the plane transport goods, boxes, and relief materials.
ifMissing: A cargo mission may have no place to carry its load.
lesson: Different planes are built for different jobs. Carrying people is not the same as carrying goods.

name: Passenger Seats
short: Seats make the plane ready for people.
function: Seats help turn a plain aircraft into a passenger-ready flight.
ifMissing: A passenger plane may work mechanically but not serve its purpose well.
lesson: Mission fit matters. The best build is not only safe, but also right for the job.

name: Fuselage
short: The main body of the plane.
function: Holds the passengers, crew, and cargo together while connecting the wings and tail.
ifMissing: There is nowhere to put the passengers, crew, or other parts.
lesson: The central structure brings everything together to make a working machine.

name: Cockpit
short: Where the pilots fly the plane.
function: Houses the instruments and controls needed to fly the aircraft safely.
ifMissing: The pilots have no place to control or monitor the flight.
lesson: Every vehicle needs a command center to guide its path.

name: Ailerons
short: Help the plane roll left or right.
function: Hinged sections on the outer wings that move up and down to tilt the plane.
ifMissing: The plane cannot turn smoothly or balance its wings.
lesson: Small adjustments make big differences in changing direction.

name: Elevators
short: Make the plane point up or down.
function: Flaps on the horizontal tail that control the pitch of the airplane.
ifMissing: The plane cannot climb into the sky or descend properly.
lesson: You need to control your angle to rise up and come back down.

name: Rudder
short: Steers the nose left or right.
function: A moving flap on the vertical tail that controls yaw.
ifMissing: The plane cannot make coordinated turns or stay straight in crosswinds.
lesson: Staying on a straight path requires a steady steering mechanism.

name: Flaps
function: Sections on the inner wings that extend down to help the plane fly slowly during takeoff and landing.
ifMissing: The plane must land and take off at dangerously high speeds.
lesson: Sometimes slowing down safely is just as important as going fast.

name: Slats
function: Extend from the front of the wing to prevent stalling at low speeds.
ifMissing: The plane might drop out of the sky when flying too slow.
lesson: Changing shape helps adapt to different phases of the journey.

name: Spoilers
short: Slow the plane down in the air.
function: Plates on top of the wings that pop up to reduce lift and increase drag.
ifMissing: The plane may float too far down the runway or descend too fast.
lesson: You need a way to hit the brakes, even when you are in the sky.

name: Horizontal Stabilizer
function: A mini-wing on the tail that prevents the nose from pitching up and down on its own.
ifMissing: The plane would constantly try to flip end-over-end.
lesson: Stability is essential for a smooth and predictable ride.

name: Vertical Stabilizer
function: The upright tail fin that stops the plane from swinging side to side.
ifMissing: The plane would wiggle violently like a fish out of water.
lesson: A strong foundation keeps you moving straight ahead.

name: Propeller
short: Pulls the plane through the air.
function: Spinning blades that create thrust on certain types of aircraft.
ifMissing: The plane sits still and cannot fly.
lesson: Rotational energy is a powerful way to move forward.

name: Spinner
function: A cone shaped cover over the center of the propeller to improve aerodynamics.
ifMissing: Air hitting the flat hub creates drag and slows the plane down.
lesson: Streamlining reduces resistance and makes the journey easier.

name: Nacelle
function: An aerodynamic housing that protects the engine and directs airflow.
ifMissing: The engine is exposed to weather and causes massive drag.
lesson: Protecting your core components ensures they work efficiently.

name: Windshield
function: Thick glass that withstands high winds and bird strikes.
ifMissing: Pilots are blinded by wind and cannot navigate visually.
lesson: Clear vision is vital for steering a safe course.

name: Altimeter
short: Tells how high the plane is.
function: An instrument that measures altitude using air pressure.
ifMissing: Pilots might fly too low and hit obstacles or too high and lose oxygen.
lesson: Knowing your exact vertical position is critical for safety.

name: Airspeed Indicator
short: Shows how fast the plane flies.
function: Measures the speed of the aircraft moving through the air.
ifMissing: The plane might fly too slow and fall, or too fast and break apart.
lesson: Speed must be carefully managed to stay in the safe zone.

name: Attitude Indicator
short: Shows if the plane is level.
function: An artificial horizon that tells pilots if they are banking or climbing.
ifMissing: Pilots can get disoriented in clouds and crash.
lesson: When you cannot trust your senses, rely on accurate data.

name: Yoke
function: The control column pilots use to pitch and roll the plane.
ifMissing: Pilots cannot guide the plane's movements by hand.
lesson: Every pilot needs a physical connection to direct their path.

name: Rudder Pedals
short: Steer the plane on the ground and air.
function: Foot pedals used to control the rudder and wheel brakes.
ifMissing: The plane cannot turn smoothly or stop safely on the runway.
lesson: Sometimes you need hands and feet working together for complete control.

name: Throttle
function: Levers pushed forward for more power and pulled back for less.
ifMissing: The plane cannot change speed or climb effectively.
lesson: Managing power is the key to managing your journey.

name: APU (Auxiliary Power Unit)
function: A small engine that generates electricity and air pressure when main engines are off.
ifMissing: The plane has no power at the gate and cannot start its main engines.
lesson: Having a reliable backup system is crucial for independence.

name: Battery
function: Provides initial power to start the APU and keeps critical systems running in an emergency.
ifMissing: The plane cannot start up or loses all screens if engines fail.
lesson: Stored energy saves the day when the main power source stops.

name: Generator
function: Driven by the engines to power lights, screens, and computers.
ifMissing: The plane goes dark and loses vital instruments mid-flight.
lesson: Continuous energy generation is needed for modern complex systems.

name: Navigation Lights
short: Show the plane's direction at night.
function: Red, green, and white lights on the wingtips and tail.
ifMissing: Other planes cannot tell which way the aircraft is traveling.
lesson: Clear communication with others helps avoid collisions.

name: Beacon Light
short: Warns people the engines are running.
function: A flashing red light that alerts ground crew to stay away.
ifMissing: Ground crew might get too close to a running engine.
lesson: Visual warnings are a simple way to maintain safety.

name: Landing Lights
function: Powerful headlights used during takeoff and landing to see the runway.
ifMissing: Pilots cannot see the ground clearly at night.
lesson: Shining a light on your immediate path helps you land safely.

name: Pitot Tube
function: A forward-facing tube that senses ram air pressure to determine speed.
ifMissing: The plane loses its airspeed reading.
lesson: Small sensors can provide the most vital pieces of information.

name: Static Port
function: A small hole on the side of the plane to sense outside air pressure.
ifMissing: The altimeter and airspeed indicator will give false readings.
lesson: You need a baseline of calm to measure against the storm.

name: Transponder
function: Sends a signal to Air Traffic Control with the plane's flight number and altitude.
ifMissing: The plane becomes an unknown, invisible dot to controllers.
lesson: Being easily identifiable keeps you integrated with the wider system.

name: Comms Radio
short: Lets pilots talk to the ground.
function: Used to speak with Air Traffic Control and other airplanes.
ifMissing: The plane is isolated and cannot receive instructions or warnings.
lesson: Communication is essential for coordinating safe travel.

name: Oxygen System
function: Drops masks and supplies oxygen if the cabin loses pressure.
ifMissing: Passengers and crew could pass out from lack of air.
lesson: Always have a life-saving backup for the things you need most.

name: Flight Data Recorder
short: Records how the plane is flying.
function: The 'black box' that saves information on speed, altitude, and controls.
ifMissing: Investigators cannot figure out why a crash happened.
lesson: Learning from past mistakes prevents future tragedies.

name: Cockpit Voice Recorder
function: Saves the audio of pilot conversations and cockpit alarms.
ifMissing: Important context about pilot decisions is lost in an accident.
lesson: Hearing the human side of an event provides the missing puzzle pieces.

name: Overhead Bins
function: Compartments above the seats for carry-on luggage.
ifMissing: The cabin gets cluttered, blocking escapes and making people uncomfortable.
lesson: Organized storage makes the journey better for everyone.

name: Galley
function: Where flight attendants prepare food and drinks.
ifMissing: Passengers go hungry and thirsty on long flights.
lesson: Comfort and nourishment are important for morale on long trips.

name: Lavatory
function: A small room with a toilet and sink.
ifMissing: Passengers suffer severe discomfort on longer flights.
lesson: Basic human needs must be met no matter where you are.

name: Pressurization System
function: Pumps air into the cabin so people can breathe at 30,000 feet.
ifMissing: The air becomes too thin to breathe, and freezing cold.
lesson: Creating a safe artificial environment lets you travel in hostile spaces.

name: Environmental Control System
function: Provides air conditioning and heating for the cabin.
ifMissing: The plane becomes freezing cold or boiling hot.
lesson: Comfort relies on a delicate balance of temperature and fresh air.

name: Fire Extinguishing System
function: Bottles of fire retardant that can be sprayed into engines or cargo holds.
ifMissing: A small fire can quickly destroy the entire aircraft.
lesson: You must be able to fight hazards immediately, even in mid-air.

name: Emergency Exits
function: Special doors and windows designed for quick evacuation.
ifMissing: Passengers get trapped inside during an emergency.
lesson: Always know your way out when things go wrong.

name: Radome
function: A fiberglass cover at the very front that protects the weather radar.
ifMissing: The radar gets destroyed by wind and rain.
lesson: Delicate instruments need tough shields.

name: Trim Tabs
function: Small flaps on the trailing edge of control surfaces that relieve pressure on the controls.
ifMissing: The pilot has to constantly push or pull hard on the yoke, getting tired.
lesson: Small adjustments take the heavy burden off the main operator.
